prompt: Our DeFi startup is launching a token on StarkNet and we need an auditable contract file ready for submission. We already have a basic token blueprint and an ownable pattern available via a local tooling script at `scripts/script.sh`. The security team requires a 'pausable' version of the token: an authorized owner must be able to halt all token transfers in an emergency, and resume them afterwards. Both the pause and the unpause actions must be traceable on-chain. Please produce a single Cairo contract file named `pausable_erc20.cairo` that satisfies these requirements, using the correct modern syntax and patterns for this platform.
